News



2026


Aug



Honored to receive support from the NSFC Young Scientists Fund (Category A).





June



Our work on alternating neural integrators (ANI) for learning missing physics from existing simulators was published in Nature Communications.

Paper



I was promoted to Full Professor at SUSTech.





Mar



Our DUE framework and open-source library for modeling unknown equations were highlighted in SUSTech’s report on research featured by the NSFC.

Research news








2025


Nov



Honored to receive the Guangdong Provincial Science and Technology Award — Youth Science and Technology Innovation Award.

Award announcement






Sept



Welcome Xuan Wu as a postdoctoral fellow, Miaosen Jiao and Zongda He as Ph.D. students, and Haoxiang Yang, Fangyu Du, and Hongye Deng as master’s students.


Received the SUSTech President’s Research Award and the Young Professor Award.

Award announcement






July



Congratulations to Huihui Cao on becoming a Research Assistant Professor in our group, and welcome Jie Xu as a postdoctoral fellow.







2024


Oct



Congratulations to Manting Peng on receiving an Outstanding Presentation Award at the 8th CSIAM Student Forum for her work on the OEDG method.

Award announcement






Sept



Welcome Caiyou Yuan as a postdoctoral fellow, Jiahe Yue as a Ph.D. student, and Yuchen Huang as a master’s student.





Jan



Our GQL framework, published in SIAM Review’s Research Spotlight, was featured by SUSTech.

Research news








2022


Oct



SUSTech highlighted our work with Yuanzhe Wei and Zheng Sun on energy laws and stability of Runge–Kutta methods, published in SIAM Journal on Numerical Analysis.
